final_message:
I've written the investment committee term sheet memo (about 8,600 words); the file passes the docx validator and reads back cleanly. It has a ranked dashboard of key issues, a term-by-term table rating each provision as market-standard or not, economics tables, a list of conflicts between the PPA and Meridian's own materials, and recommended closing conditions and diligence steps. The two deal-critical points are that the acquisition needs BVMPA's change-of-control consent (Section 14.2), and that BVMPA may still be able to reopen the price because of the 2022 Inflation Reduction Act (Section 9.4(b)).
